description: Search the official California DMV forms catalog by topic and get each form's name, its REG/DL/BOAT form number, and the page to download it from. Answers "which California DMV form transfers a title", "CA DMV form for a duplicate registration", "form to report the sale of a vehicle", or a lookup by number like "REG 227". Results follow the DMV site's own relevance ranking, so a broad phrase can surface a vessel form alongside the vehicle one.

query.description: What the form is for, e.g. "title transfer", "duplicate registration", "change of address", or a form number like "REG 227".
